high_confidence_references.title: Creeper Clan - Animation vs. Minecraft Shorts Ep 40
high_confidence_references.creator: Alan Becker

finding: Current breakout stick animation is character-action-first. Rapid visual resets work best when each beat continues one causal chain instead of behaving like an independent information card.

content_control_upgrade.name: hybrid continuity-reset grammar
rules: Keep the 2-3 second visual reset pace.
Carry at least one object, goal, obstacle, or character state across every reset.
Make finance concepts visible through character action before adding explanatory text.
Use text to label or quantify the action, not replace it.
Build one escalating physical chain from premium card to credits to calendar to annual-fee math.
Use one hard audio-visual interruption before the final payoff.
Resolve the visual problem on-screen instead of ending on a static summary card alone.
